user.title: EVN tiered electricity cost
user.description: Defaults: EVN 5-tier residential tariff from 2026-11-01 (excl. VAT). Editable later via Configure.

data_description.energy_sensors: One or more cumulative energy sensors. Multiple sensors are summed.
data_description.billing_day: Day of month the billing period starts (1-28).
data_description.vat_percent: Added to the total. Tier prices below exclude VAT.
data_description.tier_1_limit: Cumulative upper limit since period start (e.g. 100, 200, 400). Leave the last tier's limit blank. Clear a price to drop that tier.

error.no_tiers: At least one tier needs a price.
error.tier_gap: Tiers must be consecutive starting at tier 1.
error.tier_limit_missing: Every tier except the last needs a kWh limit.
